summary: Backend-only regression pass for Share a Moment batch #2. All 20 new tests (first_moment / first_comment_on_moment flags, _clean_share_moment_suggestion sanitizer, live George turn integration + prompt schema check) PASS. Full re-run of test_moments.py (38) + test_moments_comments_count_fix.py (5) = 43/43 PASS. Live George start+turn returns 200 with valid session/turns; when the LLM emits share_moment_suggestion, both text and label are present and navigate_to.moments is dropped as designed. The `share_moment_suggestion` schema is confirmed present in George's system prompt string.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700 lines (~11.2k). Not new — flagged in prior iterations — but still worth planning a module split.

In POST /api/moments the first_moment detection uses count_documents on author_id before insert. Under highly-concurrent double-tap the same user could theoretically get first_moment=true twice. Not exercised in normal use (client debounces) but worth noting.
In POST /api/moments/{id}/comments the is_first_comment check reads comments then does $push in a separate step — same race consideration. In practice unlikely to matter, but flagging.
seed_data_creation: New signup users prefixed TESTsm2_* (author, commenter, commenter2). Test moments prefixed 'TEST '. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For Share a Moment batch #2: (a) first_moment / first_comment_on_moment flags are stable and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_share_a_moment_batch2.py. (b) _clean_share_moment_suggestion sanitizer imported directly from services.george.event_creation.service — 13 unit assertions covering None/non-dict, quote stripping (straight + curly), hashtag stripping, 500-char clamp with ellipsis, label defaulting, label >40char fallback. (c) Live George turn smoke uses CMS admin JWT via /api/cms/auth/login and hits /api/mcgs/george/event/start + /session/{id}/turn — LLM output is non-deterministic so the test only asserts structural correctness when share_moment_suggestion is emitted, otherwise prints a NOTE and passes. (d) The system-prompt grep test finds the schema by scanning module-level string attributes >500 chars containing 'share_moment_suggestion'.
